description:
## Goal

Expose live source replacement only after typed source identity, atomic publication, completed attempts, movement direction, and bounded semantic support make replacement correct by construction.

`submit_source` creates a new logical `SourceOwner`. `replace_source(owner, text)` is the only replacement operation.

## Public contract

- Identical text is a no-op: preserve the accepted `SourceVersion`, allocations, generations, facts, products, and work queues.
- Parse/index/surface/conflict rejection before acceptance leaves the entire previous accepted version and its publications current.
- Acceptance atomically changes the owner's current immutable version and applies the exact validated source-contribution delta; it does not lower cold functions or warm products.
- Failures that inherently occur after acceptance—such as dependent macro execution or later semantic derivation—complete through `AttemptOutcome`, withdraw stale claims, retain exact observations/diagnostics, and retry only after relevant movement.
- Equal semantic reproduction preserves existing values/allocations/generations and wakes nobody.
- Unrelated edits invalidate nothing for a requested root. Relevant edits recompute only exact transitive dependents.
- Old versions remain only while current source, diagnostics, artifacts, macros, or retained products own them; `fz-tfn.20` later reclaims unowned versions.

## Identity and coverage

Prove distinct-owner conflicts and same-owner identical/changed replacement for functions, modules, types, structs, protocols/providers, specs, macros, generated declarations/lambdas, lazy runtime reservations, and requester expectations. Generated callable code/capture identity is semantic and source-owned, independent of display span; retained old closures and diagnostics keep their exact old version while current equal denotations reuse content identity.

Prove rejected replacement, accepted then Blocked, accepted then Failed, prior success then failure, shared publishers, relevant correction, recursive source/edge withdrawal, location-only edits, and current provenance across interpreter/native/AOT doors. The same-source item-macro case must obey the documented pre-acceptance versus post-acceptance boundary without candidate leakage or self-deadlock.

## Required deletion

Delete implicit fresh-submit replacement, old `submit_code` compatibility identity/path, demand-time whole-code duplicate discovery, overwrite/last-writer paths, provisional refresh adapters, rollback/reconciliation concepts, source-state mirrors, and stale tests/docs. Do not add a full-source/World rebuild, snapshot, global scan, or product warming.

This ticket retains the valid generated-callable and ownership contracts from `fz-tfn.45`, `fz-kdt.24`, `fz-kdt.30`, `fz-kdt.32`, and the source-replacement half of the former monolithic plan. Full public causal, semantic, product, deterministic, library, fixture, CLI, formatting, check, and strict-Clippy gates pass. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes one commit and close.
title: Expose atomic live source replacement
